info.name: Nadara API v1
info.description:
Nadara dermatology clinic platform — Sprint 1 (auth) + Sprint 2 (catalog, profile, admin).

Setup:
1. Run `php artisan serve` in the Backend folder.
2. Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` once to get the demo accounts.
3. Send any of the Login requests — the token is saved automatically into the {{token}} variable.

Demo accounts (password for all: `password`):
- admin@nadara.test
- doctor@nadara.test
- patient@nadara.test
